rationale: PV-only candidates curated from WQ-platform mining rounds. All fields (volume/close/high/low/returns/adv20/vwap) have 100% coverage on TOP200/500/1000 by construction, so the platform concentration check ('Weight is too strongly concentrated') cannot trigger from sparse data — which was the blocker for the IV+ROA factor family (R56-R62). Sharpe / turnover values below are from WQ Brain platform simulation, not local backtest. Headline picks: R74 #7 and R76 #6 from rounds 74/76 are the two independent winners under the SH>=1.30, TO<0.20, fitness>1.0 gate; both share the same direction signal but use independent magnitude sources (volume-shock vs intraday-range-shock).

candidates.rationale: vol-shock (volume / 60d mean - 1) provides low-turnover magnitude scaling; (mean(returns,252) - mean(mean(returns,252),126)) is a cross-time demeaned long return that captures recent-overshoot reversion. Subtracting the rolling time-mean of the 252d return removes the slow drift component, sharpening reversion direction. The combination passes the new gate (SH>=1.30, TO<0.20, fit>1.0) with margin.

candidates.alpha_family: Range-shock x demeaned long return (independent magnitude axis vs PV-R74-7)
candidates.rationale: Same demeaned long-return direction as PV-R74-7, but magnitude swapped from volume-shock to intraday-range-shock: ((high-low)/close - mean((high-low)/close,60)). Range-shock fires on intraday volatility spikes which are only loosely correlated with trading-intensity spikes, giving genuine portfolio independence from PV-R74-7. Slightly higher returns (0.4547) at modestly higher TO.
candidates.expression: group_neutralize(ts_decay_linear(-((high - low) / close - ts_mean((high - low) / close, 60)) * (ts_mean(returns, 252) - ts_mean(ts_mean(returns, 252), 126)), 60), subindustry)

fallback_candidates.alpha_family: adv20-shock x demeaned long return (volume-source variant of PV-R74-7)
fallback_candidates.rationale: Same family as PV-R74-7 but replaces raw volume with adv20 (20d dollar-volume average) in the shock denominator. Smoother magnitude, lower TO (0.0765) but slightly lower Sharpe. Use as a substitute for PV-R74-7 if low TO is critical.

fallback_candidates.alpha_family: Short-denom vol-shock x demeaned long return
fallback_candidates.rationale: Same family as PV-R74-7 but vol-shock denominator shortened from 60d to 20d for faster magnitude reaction. Higher returns (0.3154) at slightly higher TO (0.1495).

submission_order: 1. PV-R74-7 first  — highest Sharpe (1.50) with TO 0.107, fitness 2.45. Headline pick.
2. PV-R76-6 second — independent magnitude axis (range-shock vs volume-shock), Sharpe 1.44 / TO 0.119, fitness 2.75. Genuinely diversifies PV-R74-7.
3. PV-R75-1, PV-R75-6 are same-family substitutes for PV-R74-7. Use only if PV-R74-7 fails platform checks.
4. Legacy PV1-PV3 retained as deeper fallbacks if both R74/R76 alphas fail the platform concentration / submission check (unlikely since both use 100%-coverage PV fields).
